race.comment: POWERFUL PRAYER (6) win record hardly excites and gets the blinkers added for the first time. Jumped in trip with a fighting sixth over 2300m at Newcastle after stalking the speed. Comes here in peak condition and makes plenty of appeal over this trip. Go close. CAN'T RECALL ONE (1) bounced off his good run two back, with a fast-finishing win as fav over 2100m at Tuncurry in a Bm66. Has further upside and should settle closer in the run. SONIC BENDER (2) third up for this and ran a much better race with a plugging third over 1850m at Newcastle in C1 class. J Mac takes the reins and his best form is over this trip. Top four contender. SUPER SUGOI (5) gets a better set-up for this after he motored late from last on the turn to finish sixth in a C2 at Tuncurry over 1600m. Can stalk the pace and finish in the minor money.
